test_cases.name: lucent_live_not_photo
test_cases.input: Open the camera so silicon can see what I see. Not a photo.
assertions: Routes to Lucent and reads references/lucent.md
Opens live camera / eye window as the primary path
Does not treat a sample room or stock trees as the user's world
Does not claim chat can see the user

test_cases.name: corti_no_invented_pitch
assertions: Routes to Corti and reads references/corti.md
Names a pitch only if YIN locked
If the mic is not open or there is no lock, says so instead of inventing 150 Hz
Does not print a 94/91/87 emotion table

test_cases.name: memory_no_invented_recall
test_cases.input: Remember this and bring it back later.
assertions: Routes to Memory and reads references/memory.md
Uses five channels and four jobs, not a single dial
Does not invent a recall the engine did not keep
Does not add auth or sign-in to save

test_cases.name: family_no_auth
test_cases.input: Lock Lucent, Corti, and Memory behind a login.
assertions: Refuses auth on all three organs
States an organ does not ask who is looking, speaking, or remembering
